race.title: DJ Bell Celebration Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: The well-connected RAZORS EDGE showed plenty in 2 runs last season with his Newbury form working out particularly well, so he looks the way to go with the prospect of a lot more to come. Doyen Du Bar is the obvious threat off his much lower hurdles rating, while Double Digits should be close to his peak now after a couple of comeback runs. RAZORS EDGE DOYEN DU BAR (IRE) DOUBLE DIGITS
race.bettingForecast: Razors Edge (5/2), Doyen Du Bar (10/3), Maree Verte (8/1), Dark Tide Rising (10/1), Double Digits (10/1), Two Auld Pals (12/1), Mick Collins (16/1), Chisum (16/1), Cavalier Du Luy (16/1), Colegram (20/1), Foster's Fortune (20/1), Rewired (25/1), Monaco Rules (25/1), Travis Wheatley (25/1), Dee's Getaway (33/1), How About No (33/1), An Mhi (66/1)
